talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 18 solo PCPs winding down in Mississippi; 3 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Greenwood 38930, Vicksburg 39180, Tupelo 38801) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.

**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Leake County, Simpson County, Itawamba County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 13 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~43,200 patients across 36 at-risk practices statewide.
